# TheFrans

> Portfolio of Francis Tarectican (TheFrans) — backend-focused developer from
> Puerto Princesa City, Palawan, Philippines. IT Specialist at the Bureau of
> Internal Revenue, RDO 036. Builds and deploys production web systems for
> local Philippine businesses, primarily food, beverage, and travel/hospitality.

## Flagship project

- [Mix & Match Kain — case study](https://thefrans.is-a.dev/mix-match-kain-case-study.html): a local-first QR food-ordering system built with Node.js, Express, and WebSockets, deployed and operating under live load at a real restaurant.

## About

Backend systems developer. Freelance web development practice covering 19+
deployed client sites for cafés, restaurants, spas, hotels, and travel
agencies across Puerto Princesa and Palawan. Stack: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, GSAP,
Lenis, raw WebGL/shaders for interactive site backgrounds.
